theorem.name: P7_PROTECTED_CLASS_ELIMINATION_PATH_CELL
theorem.statement: In every P7-free graph state satisfying the frozen PATH_CELL hypotheses, the class-elimination edge xv forces the unique nonconsecutive support chord xm. Moreover xm is list-safe for x because f'(m) is already absent from L(x).

derivation: p,m,n are distinct by the exact 111 roles P,M,N.
s is in the old seed while p,n,v,x are outside the old seed and m,z are old/residual Y0 roles, so s is distinct from them.
v and x have distinct exact source types T and T_prime with distinct singleton seed colors, hence v!=x.
z is residual Y0 after x is seeded, while p,m,n,s,x are in the enlarged seed and v is in Y, so z is distinct from all six.
The PATH_CELL therefore consists of seven distinct vertices.
pm and mn are edges because M is complete to P union N in the exact 111 state.
ns is an edge because n has exact old type T_prime and s belongs to T_prime.
sx is an edge because x has exact old type T_prime and s belongs to T_prime.
xv is the class-elimination edge hypothesis.
vz is an edge because z is the chosen residual-Y0 witness of v.

nonconsecutive_pairs: p has type T while s is in disjoint T_prime
f'(p) belongs to exact L(x); p is seeded with f'(p), so px would exclude a listed color
z is residual Y0 and p is in the enlarged seed
m is original Y0 and s is old seed
f'(m) belongs to exact L(v); m is seeded
z is residual Y0 and m is in the enlarged seed
f'(n) belongs to exact L(x); n is seeded with f'(n)
z is residual Y0 and n is in the enlarged seed
v has type T while s is in disjoint T_prime
z is residual Y0 and s is in the seed
z remains residual Y0 after x is added to the seed

derivation: If xm were also a nonedge, then the six consecutive edges from O2 together with the fourteen source-forced nonedges from O3 and xm nonedge would make p-m-n-s-x-v-z an induced P7.
Therefore xm must be an edge.
The frozen C11 crossed-list authority gives f'(m) in L(v)\L(y_prime).
Therefore f'(m) is not in L(x) before the L2 seed extension.
Recognizing the already-present edge xm cannot remove a color that was present in L(x); the color f'(m) was already absent.
Thus xm is a safe support chord for the selected x list/type.

exact_scope: The theorem applies only when x is in the paired survivor list class L(y_prime) and has exact source type T_prime, so the common old-seed bridge s is bound.
It does not assert that every vertex sharing L(y_prime) has type T_prime.
It does not assert that every L2 class-elimination edge lies in PATH_CELL.
It says nothing about the xv=0 nonedge-survivor side.

supported: Within every arbitrary-size occurrence of the exact source-bound PATH_CELL, P7-freeness converts the class-elimination edge xv into a forced unique safe support chord xm.
The D5E two-edge boundary has a symbolic explanation in this cell: xv alone would complete an induced P7 unless xm is already present.
The forced chord is semantically cheap for x because its color is already excluded from x's 3-list.
not_claimed: every class-elimination edge in Lemma 11 satisfies PATH_CELL
global bounded safe-chord theorem for all L2 selections
